items.title: liangfuski/eCommerceWebsite_crawler
items.author: liangfuski
items.text: The projcect is aimed to select Chinese products with sales volume more than 1000 from the website, extracting produce code, price, shipping fee, sales, product photos, etc and saving them to MongoDB. It involves the deployment of splash to tackle javascript rendering, implementation of Redis in memory bloom filter to eliminate duplicated HTTP request, deployment of Tor-Privoxy chained proxy and certain cookies strategy to achieve anonymous web crawling
